DMA Transfer Programming:

SRC: 4000
DST: 5000
COUNT: 2
CTRL: 6
IRQEN: 1
WAIT: 120

DMA_transfer: 
    LDX #<SRC
    LDY #>SRC
    STX DMA_SRC
    STY DMA_SRC+1
    LDX #<DST
    LDY #>DST
    STA DMA_DST,X
    STY DMA_DST+1,X
    LDA #<COUNT
    STA DMA_COUNT+0,X
    LDA #>COUNT
    STA DMA_COUNT+1,X
    LDA #(COUNT AND $00FF)
    ROR A
    CLC
    ADC #$01
    ROR A
    ROR A
    STA DMA_CTRL,X
    LDA #IRQEN
    STA DMA_IRQEN,X
    LDX #WAIT
DMA_WAIT: 
    DEX
    BNE DMA_WAIT

note: 0/2 initial (one start-bit near-miss, one format collapse) + 0/1 closure (labels dropped). Slot-label discipline is the binding constraint for this model on sim stimulus; future: fewer slots per turn or labeled few-shot example.
